mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within the last month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes a slowdown in economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the last two months signals a strong supply-side response to demand, which typically leads to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the last month, it signals a tight labor market and wage inflation, leading to increased costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS increases > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% and retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 1% over the last two months, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% and RSAFS declines > 1% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1%, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (GDPC1) is positive but slowing (quarterly growth < 2%) and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising (monthly increase > 0.3%), it signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
